title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical proton
html: Proof. The argument inherits from the uniqueness of hadrons. The Hecke normal form is unique in H_3(q). Permuting the colour tubes (r, g, b) acts via inner Hecke automorphisms that fix the normal-form class, establishing the S_3-symmetry. Specifically, the three position assignments (\mathfrak{u},\mathfrak{u},\mathfrak{d}), (\mathfrak{u},\mathfrak{d},\mathfrak{u}), and (\mathfrak{d},\mathfrak{u},\mathfrak{u}) produce Hecke elements related by S_3-conjugation. They therefore reduce to the same normal form. Among feasible stabilisers, minimizing |\mathrm{tr}_M| uniquely selects the LP-optimal gluon choice (L_- = \sigma_1 \sigma_0).
